description: Zone-1 refine (#1 header · #3 date · #4 icons+dividers) — three visual invariants that AST/console pass but can silently regress the pixels. #3: the score card must show Buddhist-era Thai date ('1 มิถุนายน 2569'), never the raw ISO the bazi API returns ('2026-06-01') — a dropped formatThaiLongDate leaks the ISO. formatThaiLongDate is STRICT (shape guard + new Date round-trip): out-of-range/impossible/non-ISO dates (2026-06-31 = June 30d, 2026-06-99, 2026-13-01, 2026/06/01) all reject to '' instead of leaking '99 มิถุนายน' (goo runtime catch); the caller hides a malformed ISO rather than leaking it raw (invariant #3). #4: in-card dividers must be DASHED (Figma), not solid — a dropped `border-dashed` falls back to solid silently; chip markers must be check/x-circle SVG (Figma 333-6585/6596), not ⭐/⚠️ emoji. #1: a long name must truncate the h1 (no wrap/push) with no horizontal overflow, and the [อัพเกรด] badge + bell + avatar hold position. +1 (บอง, prod): the ground-truth ดิถี vocab (ดิถีแข็งเกินไป etc.) must NEVER be clipped to fit — fixed by moving the element line to its own full-width row below the name+cluster (was ~150px beside bell+avatar and ellipsised; now ~254px @320, worst vocab fits in 228px on one line) + removing truncate -> wrap (defensive). Teeth-proven (run-zone1-refine.ts, neg-control-first): clean good = date '1 มิถุนายน 2569' + divider computed border-style 'dashed' + 3 svgs in card + no emoji; caution cross-month '28 กุมภาพันธ์ 2569'; long-name truncates + no overflowX; worst vocab @360/@320 not clipped + full text; mut-date-iso (raw ISO leak) -> พ.ศ. gate CAUGHT; mut-divider-solid (dashed dropped) -> dashed gate CAUGHT; mut-overflow-clip (forced over-long line + truncate @320) -> clip-detector bites (verify-the-instrument) CAUGHT. gate_layer=visual (rendered-text + computed-style + geometry). Reuses utils/formate-date-thai.ts getMonthTh (no new month table). Did not touch goo's ElementLine/useHomeFortune.
